lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Review preterite through a simple weekend recap.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Monday fika conversation about the past weekend.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Asking about and summarizing a weekend in the past.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik meet on Monday and ask each other about the weekend, using a mix of regular and common irregular past-tense verbs.

main_focus.name: preterite review in weekend small talk
main_focus.description: Combine regular and common irregular preterite forms in a short natural recap.
model_examples: I lördags träffade jag en vän.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use 6-8 past-tense clauses total, including var and at least two action verbs.

allowed_supporting_grammar: sequence words: först, sedan, till slut
basic modal verbs only for closing plans

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use weekend phrases and familiar action verbs to make a compact review conversation.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks how the weekend was.
dialogue_shape.middle: They exchange short weekend recaps with one or two follow-up questions.
dialogue_shape.ending: They react warmly and shift back to the new week.

target_complexity.repetition: spiral Week 3 past-tense patterns in a realistic Monday fika

focus: what one speaker did on Saturday or Sunday
whether the weekend was calm or social

sentence_focus: one sentence beginning with i lördags
one sentence with gick or åt
one reaction phrase about the weekend
